title: Akathisia review at follow-up (F2)

patient_mappings.typed_transform: mild/moderate/marked/severe iff effect status present AND that severity recorded (BARS global 2/3/4/5 labels). Present-without-severity is required-missing (needs_clarification), never defaulted to mild. The BARS 0-9 component total is never computed or mapped.
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter; clinician rating recorded with actor and timestamp per the runtime value envelope
patient_mappings.missing_policy: effect absent is handled at the gate (not_applicable), not here. Effect present with missing severity, or missing effect record, yields needs_clarification (blocks).

patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff characteristic motor restlessness (pacing, leg/foot movements, inability to remain still beyond nonspecific fidgeting) observed seated and standing; absent_assessed iff clinician records none; else unknown_incomplete. Subjective-only restlessness maps to absent_assessed here without changing severity; movements without subjective restlessness are not severity and are flagged under attribution.
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until the field is reviewed and collected (permits inference).

patient_mappings.typed_transform: antipsychotic_associated_assessed iff clinician records akathisia associated with antipsychotic exposure after onset-timing review, medication review including antiemetics and antidepressants, and exclusion review; alternative_or_unresolved iff an alternative explanation is recorded, the differential is unresolved, or movements lack subjective restlessness (pseudoakathisia); else unknown_incomplete. Never inferred from severity, medication presence, or any BARS item score.
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter for the assessment; 4-week onset lookback and medication-change history where recorded
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference; renders establish_indication_first only when combined with unknown movements).

patient_mappings.typed_transform: review_feasible iff clinician records dose reduction or switch to a lower-akathisia-propensity agent as reviewable; constrained_psychosis_tradeoff iff constrained by psychotic-worsening tradeoff needing monitoring; else unknown_incomplete. No dose, product, threshold, or regimen detail is recorded.
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).

patient_mappings.typed_transform: routine_review iff clinician records no heightened adjunct safety flag; heightened_review iff any constituent concern is recorded (benzodiazepine respiratory, falls/cognitive, or misuse; propranolol blood-pressure or exposure); else unknown_incomplete. Per-class detail is preserved in the field and disclosed in the template; the node is an aggregate.
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).

patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff clinician records current suicidality, dysphoria, or another urgent safety concern alongside akathisia; absent_assessed iff clinician records none. Deterministic urgent flag fires from this saved value without waiting for any model output.
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields needs_clarification (required input blocks) until reviewed and collected.

applicability.expression_language: allowlisted conjunction of == comparisons on encounter.kind and the FR-21 effect status only; no arithmetic, no function calls, no note access (proposed for owner review; the S25 allowlist parser is authoritative)
required_fields: absence of conflicting values for mapped nodes
applicability.unknown_policy: effect absent yields not_applicable with reason (no inference, no CPTs, no posterior; a false gate is never a negative posterior). Effect not_assessed, missing, or conflicting yields needs_clarification and stops later questions; saving corrected input creates a new run. Missing required non-gate input (severity when present, urgent concern) yields needs_clarification. Missing optional input (motor restlessness, attribution, regimen feasibility, adjunct safety) leaves that node as unknown_incomplete; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure.

cpt_contract.row_order: child state fastest; last declared parent next; first parent slowest
cpt_contract.validation: one table per node in declared order; exact node/parent/state identity and order; no extra fields; finite numbers in [0,100]; each row sums to 100 within 1e-6; reject missing/duplicate/extra rows, strings/booleans/null, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong sums; never normalize/clip/repair

evidence_mappings.evidence: mapped mild/moderate/marked/severe state as hard evidence when effect present; missing blocks before inference
mapped state, including unknown_incomplete as an observed state

mapped present/absent_assessed state as hard evidence when assessed; missing blocks before inference

impossible_evidence_policy: fail with explicit error; never soften or approximate. All declared states (including unknown_incomplete where declared) are possible, so impossibility arises only from schema violations (undeclared node/state, conflicting evidence on one node).
reviewed_result_mapping: posterior branch rendered as review prompt only; maximum posterior is not a recommendation rule; deterministic urgent flag from saved inputs shown first and never waits for LLM; indication and urgent posteriors always rendered alongside the option branch; unknown_disclosure and context_note always appended; needs_clarification branch on required missing/conflict; not_applicable branch on gate-absent

context_output_resource_limits.note: Limits are proposed engineering ceilings for review; final values set after measuring admitted models per plan 8.3. Full-CPT payload must fit or admission is rejected; no silent truncation.

engine_configuration.elimination_order: deterministic pinned order with deterministic tie-breaking
engine_configuration.note: Pinned engine/runtime recorded at admission in S39; replay reads stored effective CPTs/evidence/query without provider calls.
